input.quote: Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
input.rationale: Section 14.2 gives Vendor exclusive ownership of Deliverables created specifically for Customer (per the 1.4 definition, which already excludes Vendor Technology and know-how) and leaves Customer only a revocable, non-transferable, term-limited licence. That contradicts our position that we own what we pay for, and it conflicts with the perpetual paid-up licence in 13.2 and the retained-rights structure in 14.1/14.3. The redline reverses the assignment to Customer while preserving Vendor's ownership of Vendor Technology and the 13.2 licence-back; fallback is at least the perpetual, irrevocable 13.2 licence. Sections 14.1 (Customer Data) and 14.4 (no joint ownership) are already compliant.

proposal.summary: Reverse Deliverable ownership to Customer with Vendor assignment
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We own the work product we pay for, so we have reversed 14.2 so that Vendor assigns each Deliverable to Customer, with Vendor Technology remaining Vendor's under 14.3 and licensed to us under 13.2. If Vendor cannot assign, our fallback is Vendor ownership of generic tools plus the perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense Deliverables in Section 13.2 — a revocable, term-limited licence is not acceptable.

ops.oldText: Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: Customer exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer, and Vendor hereby irrevocably assigns to Customer all right, title, and interest, including all intellectual property rights, in each Deliverable. Vendor retains Vendor Technology as provided in Section 14.3, and the perpetual licence in Section 13.2 applies to any Vendor Technology embedded in or required to use a Deliverable.
